purpose: Define the minimum row-level closure contract for the active Landauer benchmark rows currently most relevant to 0.13 promotion pressure: Berut 2012, Jun 2014, and the staged Hong 2016 candidate branch.

unit_contract.alternate_source_context: source may also describe heat values in kT-like normalization; runtime claim must state explicit unit basis

minimum_closure_requirements: machine-transcribed numeric point or archived raw row
explicit mapping boundary from Figure 3 support to runtime summary value and uncertainty
rows.current_gap: Figure 3 preview locator is now attached to the summary row, but numeric-point capture and stronger-surface closure remain open
rows.promotion_value_if_closed: would upgrade the strongest current Landauer row from figure-level summary provenance to a numeric-point-or-stronger-surface source package

unit_contract.alternate_runtime_note: legacy 0.028 eV context row is now kept separate from the pinned Jun source-facing asymptotic-work summary

minimum_closure_requirements: row-level measurement locator or exact table identity
declared policy that keeps the legacy 0.028 eV row out of the Jun lane or remaps it explicitly
propagated interval attachment consistent with runtime unit basis
rows.current_gap: summary-layer interval exists, but original-file identity and the final branch policy for the legacy 0.028 eV row remain open
rows.claim_ceiling_while_open: summary-layer lower-bound support only; not yet a clean row-level source-normalized benchmark
rows.promotion_value_if_closed: would create a second uncertainty-aware Landauer row and reduce dependence on the Berut summary row

unit_contract.alternate_runtime_note: current topic policy provisionally prefers the 4.2 +/- 0.9 zJ temperature-series mean because it best matches the inherited ~0.026 eV / 44%-above-limit narrative

minimum_closure_requirements: final publisher article page or equivalent final-source confirmation for the chosen quantity
declared keep_replace_remove policy for the local legacy 0.028 eV row
source-backed uncertainty attached to the same chosen quantity in runtime unit basis
rows.current_gap: preprint-level target policy exists, but the branch still lacks final-source confirmation and a closed policy for the local 0.028 eV row
rows.claim_ceiling_while_open: provisional topic-level target policy only; not yet a final source-normalized Hong benchmark row
rows.promotion_value_if_closed: would either convert the legacy mixed-lineage row into a source-mapped Hong benchmark lane or allow the legacy row to be removed cleanly

shared_policy.pair_role: These rows are the current narrowest Landauer-facing closure targets for 0.13.
do_not_overread: A filled contract does not by itself prove the UET bridge.
A row may be source-closed and still remain only a lower-bound benchmark lane.
Cross-row comparison must preserve unit explicitness; J and eV rows are not interchangeable without stated conversion.

claim_boundary: This contract narrows the minimum closure work for the current Berut, Jun, and Hong rows. It does not close source-lock or uncertainty propagation by itself.
